row.name: A Childs Garden Daycare and Learning Center LLC

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: An ant nest over a foot in length was found against the wall in the operation's front play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Most of the children's medicine observed at the investigation was not labeled with children's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions: Operation caregivers were providing Tylenol and similar medication to children under two years of age without a doctor's note despite the label on those medications requiring a doctor's consultation before use with children under two years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §746.3805(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation suffered a flood in the infant room in July of 2026 and never reported the issue to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: During the inspection, it was found that one of the dirvers for the operation had not completed their annual transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection outlets accessible to children in both the two-year old class and three-year old class were not covered by child safety covers. The Director did immediately locate new outlet covers to cover the outlets when the issue was brought to her attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation's back building suffered major damage during a January 2026 winter storm that rendered the building unsafe for human occupation. The operation did not report this until late February of 2026. The operation has now permanently closed the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that the owner blatantly disregarded the safety of the children by allowing children to be exposed to an unsafe person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that children in care were abused by daycare staff. It was determined that multiple children in care had photos obtained and utilized to create explicit content.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation it was determined that the director of the operation had knowledge of concerning behavior by a staff person and continued with that person's employment, even going so far as to rehire them after terminating them previously.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation an found deficient. A child received medical attention by a health care professional when dirt was accidentally thrown into the child's eyes. The operation did not report the incident within the required time-frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm was not working properly at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation has not reported the total number of employees that left the operation for the previous year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: A caregiver used a baby wipe to clean an eight-month-olds hands after a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: An employee did not wash their hands after changing a young child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The operation has not provided CPR  and first aid training for two caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: A vehicle used to transport children did not contain a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers present and observed caring for infants during inspection did not have current first aid and CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver who transports children did not have the required 2 hour annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: The primary infant caregiver that has been employed for over 90 days does not have the required 24 hours of pre-service.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's record was missing the following immunizations: 2 DTAP, 1 HepB, 1 Polio, 2 PCV, and 1 Hib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers present and observed caring for infants during inspection did not have current first aid and CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two caregiver records did not have documentation of completed orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: Based on observations made during inspection and information gathered, a four year old child was observed separated from the group for more than four minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The operation was recited for not properly following the requirements of the corrective action.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: A classroom with a specified age group of 12-17 months, is being used as a passageway to the outside area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Splashing/Wading Activities: During inspection, an infant classroom was observed using wading pools during water activities. There were seven infants observed, with the youngest being ten months old, and three caregivers present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Splashing/Wading Activities (26 TAC §746.2101(a))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder/director has failed to maintain consistent compliance with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Caregiver in the Infant A class served a child sitting at the table a snack on the bare table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Based on external documentation reviewed and information gathered during inspection, the director has not been maintaining attendance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during evaluation or probation: During corrective action evaluation, the operation has not met transition log requirements or observation requirements as set by CCR Inspector and Supervisor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder/director has failed to maintain consistent compliance with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Based on information gathered during the investigation, the operation's staff and director have been taking children through an unlicensed space, into the director's office for separation when "acting out." The space presents a number of hazards to the children. There is broken tile through the entrance to the space and building materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: Based on information gathered during the investigation, the director/permit holder has been separating children from the group for more than one minute per age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children at the operation do not have updated immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: One child at the operation does not have hearing and vision results on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Infant A and Toddler classroom's were both observed to have infants in seats without using the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An child in the Infant B classrooms was observed in one restrictive device for more than 20 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: One caregiver supervising children in the infant room does not have documentation of pre-service trainings completed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: The operation has three children records that do not have signed statements of policies received on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver is missing the following required topics: Emergency preparedness; Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations; Administering medication, Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; Understanding building and physical premises safety, and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: One children does not have hearing and vision results on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding plans have not be signed and updated as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The operation was observed using a YouTube video with visual aid during nap time in a multiple classroom space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: An 18 month old child in the Three's classroom does not have admission information on file at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver in the Two's class was observed not washing their hands following diapering. A caregiver in the Pre-K classroom was observed not washing their hands prior to handing food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation did not notify regulations of changes to the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: The one has one child has been enrolled at the operation over one year without a health statement. Another child's admission packet health statement section was  completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Infants and Toddlers were observed being placed at a table to eat snack, without hand washing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The Infant II/ Toddler classroom had a specified age group of 12-17 months with six children in care and one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two  infant's written feeding plan have not been signed and updated by a parent/guardian.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Caregiver in the mixed group classroom did not know how many children were in care, after transitioning from the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant's written feeding plan has not been signed by a parent/guardian.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Three children records do not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The operation has not been carrying a list of children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily: Based on information gathered during inspection and external documentation reviewed, the operations infants have not been allowed time for outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules: The operation has one crib that does not have documentation showing manufacturer type.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Promotion of Physical Activity, section has not been added to the operational polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
